item.title: Senior dog trapped at Seletar farm dies from cardiac arrest, AVS saddened by death
item.description: A senior dog that was trapped at a Seletar farm last week has died after being sent to a private vet. AVS said it's "saddened" by his death.

item.title: SBS Transit staff shouts at elderly man boarding bus at JB checkpoint, will be disciplined
item.description: An SBS Transit staff will be disciplined after being seen shouting at an elderly man who was boarding the bus at the JB checkpoint.

item.title: 73-year-old cabby sent to hospital after accident with another taxi along Upper Serangoon Road
item.description: A 73-year-old taxi driver was sent to the hospital after an accident with another taxi along Upper Serangoon Road.

item.title: Ex-teacher says in letter to MOE that initiatives to manage teachers' workload 'not reflective of reality'
item.description: An ex-teacher wrote to MOE saying that initiatives to reduce teachers' workload shared in Parliament were "not reflective of reality".

item.title: Police warn public of scammers impersonating food delivery apps, over S$42K lost since Aug
item.description: The police issued an advisory warning the public of scammers impersonating food delivery apps, saying that over S$42k had been lost sinc August.

item.title: Tourist returns 14kg of pebbles taken from Vietnam island a decade ago
item.description: A tourist has returned 14kg of pebbles he took from Vietnam's Co To Island ten years ago, along with a handwritten apology.

item.title: Man charged for importing over 2,800 vapes via Tuas Checkpoint, hid them in car compartments
item.description: A man has been charged for allegedly importing over 2,800 vapes via Tuas Checkpoint. The vapes were found hidden in his car.

item.title: 88-year-old S'porean man discards rubbish on neighbour's aircon ledge 24 times, fined S$3K
item.description: An elderly man was fined S$3,000 for repeatedly harassing his neighbour by lifting bags of rubbish onto his neighbour’s aircon ledge.

item.title: Delta Swimming Complex swimmer yanks sunglasses off lifeguard & throws it on ground
item.description: A swimmer was recorded tearing a pair of sunglasses off a lifeguard before throwing them on the ground at Delta Swimming Complex.

item.title: 185 fall ill after eating food supplied to preschools, SFA suspends Middleton International School’s kitchen
item.description: Authorities suspend Middleton International School’s kitchen after 185 people from 6 E-Bridge preschools reported gastroenteritis symptoms.
